_units: cm, degrees, servo speed/accel as Station takes them. Poses are taught (leader arm or by hand), stored as motor steps 1-8.

poses._help: Taught pose: x, y, z (m), roll, pitch, yaw (rad), steps (motor 1-8). Written by agent/teach.py, never typed by hand.

grasp._help: Gripper opening 0..1 as the IK API reports it. After closing, an opening above empty_below means something is held (jaws stalled on the pack).
grasp._relief_help: after the close stalls on a pack, the gripper goal is set this far (0..1 opening) inside the measured opening: moderate squeeze instead of a hard stall

measured._help: Fill from real runs: picks tried, held, placed, seconds per pick.

safety._help: fast true: every move is one execute request; only the IK API's own checks (reach, joint limits, table/self collision incl. along the path, stale data) and the STOP file apply. fast false: also solve first, flip guards, reach probes.

sequences._help: Step order, played by agent/real.py. Steps: home, slot.<pose>, bin.<pose>, open, close, photo, wait:<seconds>. Any <pose> name you use here becomes a pose to teach (agent/teach.py slot1 <pose>). Moves after close and before open run at the loaded speed.

free_pick._help: Free pick (pick_mode free): grab height = table + grip_z_above_table_cm (number, or per height class), hover that much higher (lower if it does not solve far out), jaws turned to the pack angle + yaw_offset_deg. Joint jump limits in motor steps: travel = motors 2-6 on the way to the hover, vertical = motors 1-6 going down/up.
